what_rules_already_say: Allowed without registration or advertising approval; conditions in TCVN 14429:2025 (voluntary): high at 10 g per 100 g or 5 g per 100 kcal; protein must be in the nutrition panel since 1 Jan 2026
proposed_revision: Specify 10 g or more per 100 g and print the number on the front; do not rely on the word alone because the per 100 kcal route lets watery foods claim high protein at 4 to 5 g per 100 g

current_text: Traceable origin and verified meat-free status
what_rules_already_say: State chay inspections check hygiene, origin papers and labels; no reported meat-DNA testing
proposed_revision: Keep; point to DMV-07 and third-party testing against TCVN 13625 vegan criteria

current_text: Honest percentage labelling; 20 to 30% replacement in giò lụa, chả, xúc xích
what_rules_already_say: No national standard sets a minimum meat content; the named meat must be quantified when the name names it; Vissan prints it on 28 of 29 meat-named formulations
status: not blocked; the product keeps its meat name
proposed_revision: Add the rule and the Vissan range (27 to 65% named lean in 21 processed-meat formulations)

current_text: Drinks with 5 g or more per 100 ml

proposed_revision: Note the naming floor for soy and that no dairy-term restriction exists

current_text: Define chay, thuần chay and suitable-for-vegetarians claims by reference to TCVN 13625 and make meat-free claims enforceable
what_rules_already_say: TCVN 13625:2023 already defines both claims but counts egg, milk and honey as vegetarian and ignores alliums; false claims are already unlawful under the goods-label rules
proposed_revision: Make TCVN 13625 vegan criteria the test for an unqualified chay or thuần chay claim, require a qualifier where egg or milk is used, leave allium-free voluntary, and fund testing (DMV-07)

current_text: Require honest percentage labelling of blended (hybrid) meat products

proposed_revision: Narrow to generic names (giò lụa, xúc xích, hotdog) through a voluntary industry code or a guidance note

current_text: Neutral naming guidance for new foods that avoids nhân tạo
